headline: Stanley Electric U.S. Co., Inc. Faces Malware Attack, Shuts Down Facilities
body: Stanley Electric U.S. Co., Inc., a leading automotive components supplier, has disclosed a significant cybersecurity incident. A malware infection spread rapidly across thousands of unpatched machines during a routine tool installation. This forced the company to temporarily shut down several production facilities. Stanley Electric U.S. Co., Inc. has engaged incident response teams to address the breach. The company is working diligently to restore operations and ensure the security of its systems.
